comment: Expected failures caused by the Kotlin SDK (kotlin-sdk master, 3af219a) or the Kotlin programs (programs/kotlin). Citations are relative to the kotlin-sdk root; M = acp-model/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/agentclientprotocol/model.

expectations.reason: Kotlin ClientCapabilities has no session field, so the Kotlin client cannot advertise session.configOptions.boolean
the Kotlin client cannot advertise session.configOptions.boolean, so no agent offers the boolean option verbose to it
Kotlin AuthCapabilities has only _meta, so the Kotlin client cannot advertise auth.terminal and no agent lists its terminal auth method
Kotlin v1 SessionUpdate.ToolCall has no name field, so the client cannot read the tool call name
